proposal.instructions:
SEMANTIC APPROVAL REQUEST — one exact O contract, not an F/O menu.

Approve unchanged means approve Authenticated availability contract v1 in the exact ADR/source hash pinned below as the successor formal-generation semantic contract. Scope10 selected only direction O; this request asks for the distinct approval of its concrete guards and changed claims. F remains forbidden.

The complete combination is mandatory: (1) AC certifies exact authenticated, context-bound, per-leaf original storage statements admitted at the original protocol prefix, not physical quorum presence at that cut; (2) canonical close includes the full accepted-AC set for RequiredTickets, with OMIT_UNAVAILABLE/ABORT_ON_INCOMPLETE interpreted exactly as ADR section4, never by a consumer's discretionary failed fetch; (3) every first data-dependent operation/vote requires the exact original committed bytes, checked arithmetic and original parent/current/quorum guards; (4) losses preserve frozen membership and downstream lineage, with existing bounded exact-ID repair, deadlines, certified abort or BLOCKED, never fabricated QC or silent omission. All ordinary actions retain OrdinaryProgressOpen and their inner guards.

Accepting this contract explicitly allows authenticated but false storage claims and loss before AC/close without assuming any storage honesty threshold. Up to all enrolled storage peers may be faulty for safety. It does not allow computation without the actual checked inputs. Honest-node durability, independent fixed-epoch authority and faithful trusted-volume provenance remain. No new factual-history observer, trust root, hidden no-loss source domain, source cap or retention interval is introduced. Liveness requires delivery of statements and actual exact bytes at use within existing budgets; all-data-lost executions cannot be promised APPLIED.

The successor refinement claim covers the complete authenticated/observed protocol state with all original source events, identities and multiplicity. Unobserved global physical cuts are environment state for fault exploration, not purportedly reconstructed native facts. The old physical available-attester quorum at AC/close is explicitly removed from the new claim. Physical loss/corruption/crash cases remain in safety exploration. This is a semantic/model/claim change, not a refinement-only proof of the old model.

ADR sections7-9 are the closed impact/qualification set: successor feature000 Init/state/Next composition and availability/close/data-use/failure framing, full source/public-state/refinement, applicable Lean composition, genuine new-guard mutants, current/lineage/recovery and exact compatibility reviews must be requalified. No concrete sigma is selected. ADR0016 byte/key/signature binding remains, but future semantics/config pins imply new-generation hashes and possibly B/b, C/c and downstream QC IDs. All legacy objects/signatures/QC/WAL keep their original bytes, identities and interpretation; no migration or relabeling.

Pending/rejected decision means STOP. Approval is semantic selection, not a passed model, proof, R2.3 closure or production GO. After an exact approved effective scope is issued and ACK persisted, use the existing R2.3 authorization only within the actual assignment and ordinary result/reviewer gates; no manual transition or gate bypass. The named recovery theorem remains after reviewed substantive R2.3 closure; full R3 remains forbidden. This request adds no production C++/ABI/Java/sidecar/recovery or guard-removal authority. If formalization requires another trust root, hidden source restriction, forbidden boundary change or fails a required safety gate, preserve NO_GO and raise that exact new semantic issue. General R2.3 permission need not be requested again. ACK itself never advances graph or creates completion/review/dequeue.

No production C++/ABI/Java/sidecar integration, production recovery deployment or arithmetic guard removal; exact compatible merged Formal GO remains required. Future feature000 semantic/model changes are those explicitly selected in this contract, never changes to the deployed legacy generation.

Preserve existing storage authentication bindings, original signer/object/QC/WAL identities and all retained delivery/source multiplicity. New generation pins/hashes must be qualified; no old-object reinterpretation, migration, relabeling or resigning. No concrete sigma_next.

F is forbidden. No factual-history observer, new trust/authority root, hidden source-domain restriction, invented source caps, loss/fault erasure, lineage truncation or replacement of missing bytes with successful callbacks. The revised physical-cut claim is explicit, not evidence that the old claim passed.

Preserve fixed-epoch enrolled Snapshot Provenance Profile v1 authority and deployment boundaries: no unenrolled node, epoch change, trusted-volume compromise/rollback, network bootstrap or universal backup format.

R1/R2.1/R2.2 stay CLOSED for their original domains. R2.3 stays OPEN until substantive reviewed proof. Named DeltaReduce.nativeArithmeticRecoveryRefines only after reviewed R2.3 closure; full R3 forbidden. No conditional refinement portrayed as production GO.

No sorry, hidden/circular/public-success axioms, vacuous theorem/domain weakening, opaque accept callbacks or relabeled FAIL/NO_GO. Requalify every affected source/model/refinement/mutant/compatibility/review gate; sequential self-review is not independent attestation.

No new sprint, reimport, reset, manual graph advancement, fake RESUME/START for STOP, duplicate result/review, nginx-qa patch/deploy/restart, subagents, foreign-file changes or frozen-ref rewrites. Preserve history and healthy demos. ACK removes only scope authorization and never advances graph or bypasses another gate.
